heads.t: 平息資料中心電價民怨！SpaceX砸千億替亞利桑那升級電網 美國期中選舉後，選民對資料中心推高民生電價的不滿情緒升溫。SpaceX近日宣布在亞利桑那州投資逾500億美元（約新台幣1.65兆元）打造資料中心，更開出「自付電費、砸36億美元（約新台幣1,186億元）升級電網」的優渥條件換取地方支持。但外媒分析，在資本支出暴增與高息舉債壓力下，升級電網背後的資金成本越來越沉重。 23 分鐘前｜國際 平息資料中心電價民怨！SpaceX砸千億替亞利桑那升級電網 23 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: Following the mid-term election in the United States, the electorate's dissatisfaction with the Center's push to raise the cost of electricity to the population has increased. SpaceX recently announced that it would invest more than $50 billion (approximately $165 trillion) in Arizona to build a data centre, and that it would provide local support for the favourable terms of the "out-of-pocket electricity bill and $3.6 billion (approximately $118.6 billion) to upgrade the electricity network." However, the cost of capital behind the upgraded grid is becoming more and more heavy in the face of a surge in capital spending and high interest-rate debt pressure. Twenty-three minutes ago, the international data center put an end to its electricity-price grievances!
